Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East holds 194 vials of norepinephrine bitartrate 1 mg/mL 4 mL (33.3 days on hand at 5.8 vials per day). Corvale General holds 134 vials of the same presentation (21.9 days on hand at 6.1 vials per day).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include norepinephrine bitartrate as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers roughly three to five weeks at present usage. No FDA shortage listing exists to trigger allocation or allocation‑waiver pathways. A product label names ADAPTIS as the manufacturing plant for a norepinephrine bitartrate product labeled by Avenacy, LLC.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Anthea Pharma Private Limited (not on FDA shortage list today) — requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to place orders with BE Pharmaceuticals Inc. (not on FDA shortage list today) — requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to place orders with BIOCON PHARMA INC. (not on FDA shortage list today) — requires P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to place orders with Baxter Healthcare Company (not on FDA shortage list today) — requires P&T committee approval.
5. Buyer to place orders with Baxter Healthcare Corporation (not on FDA shortage list today) — requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing or protocol changes; those remain the responsibility of treating clinicians and the committee.
